testcase.name: Scenario: Close a docked panel and restore it from the interface menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-docking-system-source/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:118:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Close a docked panel and restore it from the interface menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And a dockable panel is the active tab in a dock region ✔ When the user closes the panel ✔ Then the panel is removed from the visible workspace ✔ And the remaining dock regions and viewport use the freed space ✔ When the user opens the interface visibility menu ✔ And the user selects the closed panel ✔ Then the panel is restored to the workspace ✔ And its contents are visible
